newsitem.title: USA: United Illuminating sees lower retail revs.
newsitem.headline: United Illuminating sees lower retail revs.

text.p: United Illuminating Co said Monday that, as a result of a December 31, 1996, order by regulators to cut customer rates, it expects its retail revenues for 1997 to drop by about $15 million for 1997 from 1996 levels.
The reductions will be partially offset by about $3 milion in accelerated recovery of certain conservation costs, it said.
The company said revenues will decline further by about $6 million due to the suspension of the so-called fossil fuel adjustment clause.

It said that, while it cannot predict the direction of fuel prices in 1997 and whether it can mitigate the entire loss of the revenue arising from the clause, it said was engaged in hedging activities to limit exporue to increased in fossil fuel prices.
